name: Sample Snapjaw Shell
summary: A Sample Snapjaw Shell is a durable tortoise carapace harvested from the freshwater oases of the Barrens. Remarkable for its lingering vitality, it is sent across the Great Sea to aid druidic research into rejuvenating the blighted woodlands of Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Spark of Oasis Life
sections.body: The snapping turtles that dwell in the lush, anomaly-tinged oases of the Barrens possess shells of surprising vigor. Unlike common shell matter, a fresh Sample Snapjaw Shell retains a faint inner radiance and an energetic pulse long after being separated from the creature. To the tauren druids observing the land's rapid ecological shifts, these carapaces embody the resilient, adaptive spark of Kalimdor's wilderness, suggesting that nature can flourish even amidst harsh arid surroundings.

sections.title: Healing Distant Lands
sections.body: Recognizing the latent vitality within the shell, tauren naturalists dispatch couriers across the sea to deliver specimens to Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher. Stationed within the blighted expanses of Silverpine Forest, Mura seeks to aid the Forsaken by finding ways to heal the afflicted northlands. By examining the enduring life-force preserved inside the snapjaw's armor, she hopes to isolate secrets that can revitalize an ailing forest and encourage new growth in dying soil.

faq.q: What makes this snapjaw shell special?
faq.answer: Unlike brittle mundane bone, this carapace retains an inner glow and seems to still pulse with life after collection. It comes from the snapjaws flourishing around the strange freshwater oases of the Barrens, where natural energies run unusually high.

The shell is destined for Mura Runetotem, a tauren druid dwelling at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. She traveled to the Eastern Kingdoms to assist the Forsaken and study how to bring dying lands back to life.

faq.q: Why send a Barrens shell all the way to Silverpine?
faq.answer: Silverpine is an ailing, corrupted woodland, whereas the Barrens oases have suddenly exploded with stubborn, persistent life. The druids believe studying the robust vitality locked in Kalimdor's beasts might grant insight into healing Lordaeron's blighted soil.

faq.q: Is the shell dangerous or tainted?
faq.answer: No. The shell radiates pure vitality rather than dark magic. While the sudden overgrowth in the Barrens' oases is mysterious, the druids perceive this lingering energy as a natural resilience worth cultivating.

angles.text: For druids of the Cenarion circle, studying the resilient vitality of oasis snapjaws provides crucial lessons in how life perseveres and how blighted ground might one day be healed.
The delivery of this shell highlights the tauren commitment to the Earth Mother, demonstrating their willingness to extend aid and natural healing even to their undead allies across the sea.
